name: Johan Van Overtveldt - Après le § 9 - Am 2
title: REPORT on the European Central Bank – annual report 2025
part_text: 9a. Expresses concern over the high cost of living, as food and energy prices have increased in Europe since the COVID-19 pandemic; notes that, on average, the price of a meal in the euro area in 2025 was one third higher than before the pandemic1a, and that this has particularly affected low-income households. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a [European Central Bank blog, ‘When groceries bite, the role of food prices for inflation in the euro area’, 25 September 2025](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/blog/date/2025/html/ecb.blog20250925~7fd65a388a.en.html).
